Chapter 758: Chapter 35: Transformation of Power (Please Subscribe)_3

The most crucial aspect was that Lin Yuan wasn’t cultivating as an Eleventh-Rank Life, but instead he had bridged this gap at the Tenth Rank Life Level.

“Comprehending many of the Fusion Rules went smoothly, but with the Space-Time Rule… there seemed to be some difficulties,”

With a shift in thought, Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

The Space-Time Rule, formally known as the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, is among the most arduous and abstruse of the Fusion Rules, without equal.

And comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is one of the thresholds that an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse must cross to reach the ultimate existence.

The importance of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, thus, can be imagined.

...

Comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule means that the space and time of one’s Inner World are unified, resulting in a more stable and perfect transformation towards the Inner Universe, ensuring a steadier transition.

Moreover, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule plays a significant role in freeing an Eleventh-Rank Life from the constraints of the River of Time, allowing an Eleventh-Rank Life to step out of the River of Time for longer periods, thereby fighting for more time to strive for the ultimate.

“Perhaps it’s somewhat unrealistic for me to want to comprehend the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the Tenth Rank,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that even for an Eleventh-Rank Life, once the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule was comprehended, one would instantly rise to the Fourth Layer, and by raising the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule to the Fifth Realm, one would be qualified to challenge the ultimate.

What Lin Yuan wanted to do at the Tenth Rank was something only an Eleventh-Rank Life at the Fourth Layer could achieve… and this wasn’t simply a matter of combat foundation, but rather a pure comprehension of the rules.

Ultimately, Tenth Rank Life was still somewhat inferior; it didn’t have the same ease as an Eleventh-Rank Life in sensing the fluctuations of the Space-Time Rule.

“Enough, even without mastering the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, with my perception, once I step into the Eleventh Rank, I will be able to comprehend it quickly.”

Lin Yuan ceased his contemplation.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s true body sat cross-legged.

“Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter?”

Decades ago, Lin Yuan had been contemplating the inception of the Tenth Rank Chapter.

Since comprehending the Life and Death Samsara Rule, Lin Yuan was considered Grade A at the Tenth Rank, the peak of Tenth Rank, qualified to embark on the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, all the more so now that Lin Yuan’s Life and Death Samsara Rule had long reached the Fourth Realm.

“My Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter must be unique,”

Over the decades, Lin Yuan had attempted to create hundreds of beginnings for the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, but none proved satisfactory.

The evolutionary path of human civilization, from First Rank to Eleventh Rank, doesn’t see the Tenth Rank as the most crucial nor as the strongest in combat power, but it still serves a pivotal role in bridging the past and unlocking the future.

Especially for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the Tenth Rank Chapter is of utmost importance.

“The Tenth Rank path I’ve taken cannot be replicated, so the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter should address all Tenth Rank Evolvers,”

Lin Yuan thought rapidly in his mind, continuously forming the various intricacies of the Tenth Rank Chapter.

…

Outside the Milky Way Main Star.

A young-looking man with eyes that bore a hint of world-weariness suddenly appeared.

“I spent all the Merit Points I’ve accumulated, and also borrowed eighty million Merit Points in the name of my clan from human civilization, bringing the total to one hundred million Merit Points in exchange for an opportunity that could bring me one step closer…”

The man with the vicissitudes in his eyes was named Xuanyuan Fan, an ancient Tenth Rank Evolver from the Xuanyuan Family.

In terms of strength, Xuanyuan Fan ranked among the top ten of all Tenth Rank Evolvers in human civilization, and was much stronger than Nalan, the assistant tower master, before her breakthrough.

Because Xuanyuan Fan had comprehended two pillar-level Fusion Rules, among which the Life and Death Samsara Rule had reached the peak of the First Realm.

However, without stepping into the Second Realm, Xuanyuan Fan could not challenge the Eleventh Rank, and to elevate the Life and Death Samsara Rule to the Second Realm was no longer a matter of arduous cultivation but required the aid of an external force.

“According to the ancestor’s intention, the Galaxy Master holds a heritage site that could further my Life and Death Samsara Rule, but it requires a payment of one hundred million Merit Points…”

Xuanyuan Fan felt somewhat pained.

Even as an Evolver from the Xuanyuan Family, constantly fighting on the battlefield for human civilization, he had only amassed twenty million Merit Points until now.

Had it not been for his family’s reputation, he wouldn’t have been able to gather close to one hundred million Merit Points.

Even if he did gather enough, he would still need to repay eighty million Merit Points to human civilization. Even if Xuanyuan Fan luckily stepped into the Eleventh Rank, it would take him millions to tens of millions of years to repay that amount.

“I wonder which heritage site could be worth one hundred million Merit Points? But the ancestor wouldn’t deceive me,” Xuanyuan Fan thought.

It was precisely on the advice of the Xuanyuan Family’s ancestor that he had made such a choice. The ancestor of the Xuanyuan Family was one of the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization.

“The Galaxy Master… the strongest genius of human civilization to date, who stepped into the Tenth Rank two hundred years ago…” Xuanyuan Fan’s mind flashed through Lin Yuan’s information.

“What a lucky fellow…” Xuanyuan Fan envied in his heart. A heritage site that was worth one hundred million Merit Points for just a single entry, its true value was immeasurable.

Hum.

Shortly after Xuanyuan Fan arrived at the Milky Way Main Star, he contacted Lin Yuan through the virtual network.

A moment later.

A young man appeared not far away.

“Galaxy Master…” Xuanyuan Fan looked at the quietly arriving young man, his expression changing slightly.

His own perception of the Life and Death Samsara Rule had also reached the peak of the First Realm, so he vaguely sensed the Great Wheel of Samsara condensing within Lin Yuan.

In front of this vast Great Wheel of Samsara, Xuanyuan Fan felt like an ant, which could be obliterated at any moment.

“Wasn’t the Galaxy Master just at the initial stage of the Tenth Rank? Why is his aura so terrifying, and his comprehension of the Life and Death Samsara Rule so profound?”

Xuanyuan Fan was shocked. Although he didn’t know to what extent Lin Yuan’s Life and Death Samsara Rule had reached, it was undoubtedly far beyond his own.

“It’s terrifying… Is this the first genius of our human civilization?” Originally, Xuanyuan Fan didn’t pay much attention to Lin Yuan, but at this moment, his spirit couldn’t help but quiver.

“Galaxy Master, here are one hundred million Merit Points…” Xuanyuan Fan said with utmost respect, and transferred one hundred million Merit Points to Lin Yuan.

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded and also sent over the coordinates of the black planet.

The Star Domain where the black planet was located now belonged to Lin Yuan. Without permission, any citizen who trespassed on the black planet was violating the laws of human civilization, and Eleventh-Rank Evolvers were no exception.

“One hundred million Merit Points received.”

Lin Yuan watched Xuanyuan Fan leave with respect, feeling quite pleased.

He then gazed towards a certain part of the Cosmic Starry Skies, the location of the Two-dimensional World.
